inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
let AtlasLogs = tfe_fluent_bit_CL
| where component_s == "atlas";
//
// 1) Run lifecycle events from the Audit Log JSON
let RunAudit = AtlasLogs
| where log_s has "[Audit Log]"
| extend RequestId = extract(@'\[([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12})\]', 1, log_s)
| extend AuditJson = parse_json(extract(@'\[Audit Log\]\s(\{.*\})$', 1, log_s))
| extend Resource    = tostring(AuditJson.resource),
         RunAction    = tostring(AuditJson.action),
         RunId        = tostring(AuditJson.resource_id),
         Organization = tostring(AuditJson.organization),
         Actor        = tostring(AuditJson.actor),
         ActorIp      = tostring(AuditJson.actor_ip),
         EventTime    = todatetime(AuditJson.timestamp)
| where Resource == "run";
//
// 2) Start = run "create" event — SourceIp comes straight from actor_ip, no join needed
let RunStart = RunAudit
| where RunAction == "create"
| project RunId, Organization, RequestedBy = Actor, SourceIp = ActorIp, StartTime = EventTime, RequestId;
//
// 3) End = run reaches a terminal state
let RunEnd = RunAudit
| where RunAction in ("finished", "errored", "canceled", "discarded")
| summarize EndTime = max(EventTime), EndState = any(RunAction) by RunId;
//
// 4) Trigger method/client: the POST /api/v2/runs call sharing the same request id
let RunSource = AtlasLogs
| where log_s has '"path":"/api/v2/runs"' and log_s has '"method":"POST"'
| extend RequestId = extract(@'"uuid":"([0-9a-fA-F\-]{36})"', 1, log_s)
| extend ReqJson = parse_json(log_s)
| extend AuthSource = tostring(ReqJson.auth_source),
         UserAgent   = tostring(ReqJson.user_agent)
| extend Client = case(
    UserAgent has "HashiCorp Terraform", "Terraform CLI",
    UserAgent has "go-http-client",      "API client / agent",
    UserAgent has "Mozilla",             "Web UI (browser)",
    "Other")
| project RequestId, AuthSource, Client, UserAgent;
//
// 5) Workspace name, pulled from task-worker execution logs keyed by run_id
let RunWorkspace = tfe_fluent_bit_CL
| where component_s == "task-worker"
| extend WJson = parse_json(log_s)
| extend RunId = tostring(WJson.run_id), Workspace = tostring(WJson.workspace_name)
| where isnotempty(RunId) and isnotempty(Workspace)
| summarize Workspace = any(Workspace) by RunId;
//
// Combine everything
RunStart
| join kind=leftouter RunEnd on RunId
| join kind=leftouter RunSource on RequestId
| join kind=leftouter RunWorkspace on RunId
| project
    RunId,
    Organization,
    Workspace,
    RequestedBy,
    SourceIp,
    AuthSource,
    Client,
    StartTime,
    EndTime,
    Duration = EndTime - StartTime,
    EndState
| order by StartTime desc

    | where component_s == "atlas";
//
// 1) Run lifecycle events from the Audit Log JSON
let RunAudit = AtlasLogs
    | where log_s has "[Audit Log]"
    | extend RequestId = extract(@'\[([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12})\]', 1, log_s)
    | extend AuditJson = parse_json(extract(@'\[Audit Log\]\s(\{.*\})$', 1, log_s))
    | extend
        Resource = tostring(AuditJson.resource),
        RunAction = tostring(AuditJson.action),
        RunId = tostring(AuditJson.resource_id),
        Organization = tostring(AuditJson.organization),
        Actor = tostring(AuditJson.actor),
        ActorIp = tostring(AuditJson.actor_ip),
        EventTime = todatetime(AuditJson.timestamp)
    | where Resource == "run";
//
// 2) Start = run "create" event — SourceIp comes straight from actor_ip, no join needed
let RunStart = RunAudit
    | where RunAction == "create"
    | project
        RunId,
        Organization,
        RequestedBy = Actor,
        SourceIp = ActorIp,
        StartTime = EventTime,
        RequestId;
//
// 3) End = run reaches a terminal state
let RunEnd = RunAudit
    | where RunAction in("finished", "errored", "canceled", "discarded")
    | summarize EndTime = max(EventTime), EndState = any(RunAction) by RunId;
//
// 4) Trigger method/client: the POST /api/v2/runs call sharing the same request id
let RunSource = AtlasLogs
    | where log_s has '"path":"/api/v2/runs"' and log_s has '"method":"POST"'
    | extend RequestId = extract(@'"uuid":"([0-9a-fA-F\-]{36})"', 1, log_s)
    | extend ReqJson = parse_json(extract(@'(\{.*\})$', 1, log_s))   // <-- fix: strip the log-line prefix before parsing
    | extend
        AuthSource = tostring(ReqJson.auth_source),
        UserAgent = tostring(ReqJson.user_agent)
    | extend Client = case(
                          UserAgent has "HashiCorp Terraform",
                          "Terraform CLI",
                          UserAgent has "go-http-client",
                          "API client / agent",
                          UserAgent has "Mozilla",
                          "Web UI (browser)",
                          "Other"
                      )
    | project RequestId, AuthSource, Client, UserAgent;
//
// 5) Workspace name, pulled from task-worker execution logs keyed by run_id
let RunWorkspace = tfe_fluent_bit_CL
    | where component_s == "task-worker"
    | extend WJson = parse_json(log_s)
    | extend RunId = tostring(WJson.run_id), Workspace = tostring(WJson.workspace_name)
    | where isnotempty(RunId) and isnotempty(Workspace)
    | summarize Workspace = any(Workspace) by RunId;
//
// Combine everything
RunStart
| join kind = leftouter RunEnd on RunId
| join kind = leftouter RunSource on RequestId
| join kind = leftouter RunWorkspace on RunId
| project
    RunId,
    Organization,
    Workspace,
    RequestedBy,
    SourceIp,
    AuthSource,
    Client,
    UserAgent,
    StartTime,
    EndTime,
    Duration = EndTime - StartTime,
    EndState
| order by StartTime desc

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
tfe_fluent_bit_CL
| where component_s == "task-worker"
| extend Json = parse_json(log_s)
| extend WorkloadType  = tostring(Json.workload_type),
         WorkloadId    = tostring(Json.workload_id),
         Workspace     = tostring(Json.workspace_name),
         Organization  = tostring(Json.organization_name),
         EventTime     = todatetime(Json["@timestamp"])
| where WorkloadType in ("Plan", "Apply")
| extend Day = bin(EventTime, 1d)
| summarize PlanCount  = dcountif(WorkloadId, WorkloadType == "Plan"),
            ApplyCount = dcountif(WorkloadId, WorkloadType == "Apply")
          by Workspace, Day
| extend WorkspaceDay = strcat(Workspace, " – ", format_datetime(Day, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))
| project WorkspaceDay, PlanCount, ApplyCount
| order by WorkspaceDay asc
| render barchart with (xcolumn=WorkspaceDay, ycolumns=PlanCount, ApplyCount, kind=unstacked)

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
let RunAudit = tfe_fluent_bit_CL
| where component_s == "atlas" and log_s has "[Audit Log]"
| extend AuditJson = parse_json(extract(@'\[Audit Log\]\s(\{.*\})$', 1, log_s))
| extend Resource  = tostring(AuditJson.resource),
         RunAction = tostring(AuditJson.action),
         RunId     = tostring(AuditJson.resource_id),
         EventTime = todatetime(AuditJson.timestamp)
| where Resource == "run"
| where RunAction in ("planning", "planned", "applying", "applied", "errored", "canceled", "discarded");
//
RunAudit
| summarize HasApplying = countif(RunAction == "applying") > 0,
            (MaxEventTime, LastAction) = arg_max(EventTime, RunAction)
          by RunId
| extend PlanStatus = case(
    HasApplying,              "Passed",   // reached apply => plan must have succeeded
    LastAction == "planned",  "Passed",
    LastAction == "errored",  "Failed",
    "Other")                              // canceled / discarded during plan
| summarize Count = count() by PlanStatus
| render piechart

inputs.value:
let RunAudit = tfe_fluent_bit_CL
| where component_s == "atlas" and log_s has "[Audit Log]"
| extend AuditJson = parse_json(extract(@'\[Audit Log\]\s(\{.*\})$', 1, log_s))
| extend Resource  = tostring(AuditJson.resource),
         RunAction = tostring(AuditJson.action),
         RunId     = tostring(AuditJson.resource_id),
         EventTime = todatetime(AuditJson.timestamp)
| where Resource == "run"
| where RunAction in ("planning", "planned", "applying", "applied", "errored", "canceled", "discarded");
//
RunAudit
| summarize HasApplying = countif(RunAction == "applying") > 0,
            (MaxEventTime, LastAction) = arg_max(EventTime, RunAction)
          by RunId
| where HasApplying                       // only runs that actually reached apply
| extend ApplyStatus = case(
    LastAction == "applied",  "Passed",
    LastAction == "errored",  "Failed",
    "Other")                              // canceled / discarded during apply
| summarize Count = count() by ApplyStatus
| render piechart

inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
tfe_fluent_bit_CL
| where component_s == "metrics"
| extend Json = parse_json(log_s)
| extend Name = tostring(Json.metric.Name)
| where Name in ("sidekiq.sidekiq.busy", "sidekiq.sidekiq.enqueued", "sidekiq.sidekiq.scheduled",
                 "sidekiq.sidekiq.retries", "sidekiq.sidekiq.failed", "sidekiq.sidekiq.dead")
| extend EventTime = todatetime(Json["@timestamp"]), Value = toreal(Json.metric.Value)
| summarize Value = avg(Value) by Name, bin(EventTime, 1m)
| render timechart
